summary: Software Architect hero source image: an isolated full-body hero pose of the Software Architect stakeholder on a clean white or very light background. The figure is an adult man with dark curly hair and a grey side streak, a neatly trimmed beard, and black rectangular glasses. He wears an olive-brown blazer over a cream or white shirt, dark navy trousers, and brown casual shoes, with a blue lanyard and hexagonal system/module badge. He holds a tablet showing a system architecture diagram (cloud icon, central module cube, connected boxes, database cylinder, arrows, and green data blocks) and a rolled blueprint under one arm. The style matches the Issue #56 stakeholder pack: clean vector-adjacent painterly rendering, simplified readable props, and a calm, technically grounded, approachable mood. Intended as the canonical hero source for the Software Architect, pending pixel-level review.
